content: संदीपन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Kindling, inflaming, exciting; संदीपना एव दुःखस्य प्रियसखीविनोदनोपायाः <ls>U. 3</ls>. .²2 Provoking; <ls>U. 4</ls>. .{@-नः@} One of the five arrows of Cupid. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Kindling, inflaming. .²2 Exciting, stimulating; अनङ्गसंदीपनमाशु कुर्वते <ls>Ṛs. 1. 12</ls>. .{@-नी@} (in music) A particular श्रुति.
